reasons: Section 2.2 imposes a full-term 'sole and exclusive provider' obligation on Customer with no category limit, no 12-month cap, and no performance-based exit — this is the rule's walk-away scenario and clearly fails the fallback, so a deviation finding is correct.

The redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted rewrite: 'sole and exclusive' becomes 'non-exclusive' and adds an express right to source from third parties; the 0.65 changed-character ratio is an artefact of a short single-sentence clause that must be reworded, not an over-broad edit, and no exclusivity benefiting Customer is removed.

The comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position, notes the internal conflict with Sections 2.1 and 12.3, and offers the category-specific 12-month fallback with performance exit — consistent with tone and prefix requirements.
